text: In California, you can have a friend drop off your mail ballot for you.
seenIn: a relative’s Facebook post calling it illegal

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: Vote by Mail
truthSource.oneLine: Anyone may return your ballot for you, as long as they aren’t paid per ballot.

lesson.tip: Some states restrict who can return a ballot, so posts call it illegal everywhere. Election law is set state by state; a rule from one state proves nothing about yours.
